divergences.title: ROTATION / CREDIT DIVERGENCE
divergences.headline: Cyclical rotation without credit confirmation
divergences.detail: Cyclicals are outperforming defensives by 0.68 pts while HY spreads are +22 bp over 5 days. Equity rotation is risk-on, but credit conviction is deteriorating.

whatChanged.fact: HY OAS +16 bp on the day (as of Nov 5)

synthesis.esContext: Equity strength lacks credit confirmation, so bullish ES structure has less cross-market support than the tape alone suggests.

analysis.narrative: Equities are advancing with semiconductor leadership, but equal-weight participation is lagging. Credit spreads are widening and volatility is in backwardation, confirming broader financial stress. Treasury yields are little changed on the week, so rates are not a driver. Equity strength is not being confirmed by credit, which has historically tended to lead.
